'''Rik's Cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Undercity]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a frequent haunt of [[Cade Skywalker]], [[Deliah Blue]], and [[Jariah Syn]] around [[137 ABY]] that appeared to be on the very planetary surface itself. It was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jool]], who lived in a swamp below the cantina. Jool enforced a strict no-fighting rule within, and had a cybernetic eye, with which she could monitor the goings on throughout. The bartender was [[Finn (bartender)|Finn]], a no-nonsense being who would not hesitate to use deadly force to enforce the house rules. A common fixture at Rik's was the gambler [[Naxy Screeger]].

[[Viewscreen/Legends|Holoscreens]] transmitting [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] and live dancers entertained the clientele.

In [[137 ABY]], Cade stopped by the bar before his attempt to infiltrate the [[Temple of the Sith]] and leave Jool instructions in case he did not return: to hand over the access codes to the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] to Jariah and Deliah. Also expected Deliah and Jariah were [[Chak (Wookiee)|Chak]] and [[Kee (Devaronian)|Kee]], who had rented their ship, the ''[[Grinning Liar]]'' to them. After seeing Cade, they hoped to intimidate him into revealing his crew's whereabouts, but failed.

The [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jak (Nautolan)|Jak]] passed Cade as he entered the bar. He was the club's bouncer.
